title: E87 TitanDrive head unit (centre stack)
subtitle: Schematic: what an Android head-unit install needs on an automatic-climate E87.
disclaimer: Kits differ for automatic vs manual climate and PDC vs non-PDC cars. Check the exact listing before buying.

parts.name: Android head unit (BMW-specific)
parts.info: Wanted: CarPlay, Android Auto, custom launcher, own APKs, later a live OBD2 dash. No reversing camera needed.

parts.name: Fitting frame (automatic climate version)
parts.info: Frames are sold separately for automatic and manual climate. Yours is AUTOMATIC.

parts.name: Factory climate panel (keep)
parts.info: Your automatic climate panel with digital temperature displays stays; the frame must leave room for it.

parts.name: CAN-bus / steering-control interface
parts.info: Keeps the steering-wheel buttons working and feeds car data to the unit.

parts.name: OBD2 adaptor (later: live dash)
parts.info: OBD2 port is in the driver's footwell. A Bluetooth or USB adaptor can feed your TitanDrive dashboard app.

steps.title: Confirm the car's setup
steps.text: Automatic climate confirmed. Check the radio type and whether you have parking sensors before choosing the kit.

steps.title: Check the listing
steps.text: Share the exact listing or model with Titan. Check it supports wired/wireless CarPlay and Android Auto, lets you install your own APKs and launcher, and includes the auto-climate frame and CAN-bus lead.

steps.title: Fit
steps.text: Disconnect the battery, remove the old radio, connect the CAN-bus lead and aerial adaptor, test everything before clipping the frame home.

steps.title: Later: live OBD2 dashboard
steps.text: Add an OBD2 adaptor and run your own dashboard APK on the head unit.
